name: Factorial decompositions into distinct factors above the index
description: Return 1..12 DISTINCT integers all greater than 12, with product exactly 12!. Minimize the LARGEST factor; the number of factors is variable. Exact finite version of equation (6). Distinct from the existing 100! benchmark: no fixed factor count, all factors must exceed 12, and the objective minimizes the largest rather than maximizing the smallest.

state_of_the_art.statement: 12! is a product of distinct integers from 13 to 33 and not of distinct integers from 13 to 32 (exhaustive search over the divisors of 12!), so the optimum is 33. In equation (6) of Erdős and Graham (1980, p. 75) this is the least n + i_k for n = 12.
